sourceTitle: Lady Cadogan's Illustrated Games of Solitaire or Patience New Revised Edition, including American Games
description: "Lady Cadogan's Illustrated Games of Solitaire or Patience" by Lady Adelaide Cadogan is a comprehensive guide on various solitaire card games, originally published in the early 20th century. This book serves as a manual for both traditional and American solitaire variations, emphasizing the rules and strategies for playing patience games.
